title: The Flayed Steward
text: The Commons' steward is found nailed to the door of the Hall of Accounts, his skin folded neatly on the step beside him like a coat. The ledgers he kept are missing. The city wants a name, and every House has one to give.

options.label: Name the House that did it, and give the magistrates their answer.

outcomes.text: You give your name to the magistrates in a sealed letter.

options.label: Let one of your servants confess, ending it before the Houses turn on each other.

outcomes.text: Your servant hangs at dawn, and the city breathes out. Nobody believes it, yet everybody is grateful.
Your servant hangs. On the gibbet he names the real killers in a voice that is not his, and the crowd goes home very quiet.

options.label: Say nothing, and lock away the ledgers you still have.

outcomes.text: You keep your counsel. By morning the steward's skin is gone from the step.

blamed.text: The mob gathers at their gates with torches, holding the steward's empty face up on a pole. By morning their finest building is ash. The city sleeps easier.
